items.q: Why do postmodernists reject Murdock's universal nuclear family thesis?
items.correct: Family forms are now diverse and fluid - no single type dominates.
items.misconception: Because nuclear families no longer exist at all.
items.random_wrong: Because Marx proved families are exploitative.
items.why: Students overstate the postmodern position. Nuclear families still exist; the point is that they are one form among many (lone-parent, reconstituted, same-sex, cohabiting).

items.q: Which method joined a Glasgow gang via covert observation in 1973?
items.why: The answer examiners want is: Patrick. “Hochschild” is the distractor this question was built around — if it tempted you, that's the exact gap to close.

items.q: CSEW captures crime that official statistics miss — what does it measure?
items.why: It's Victim experiences. “Police reports” is the classic near-miss here; knowing why it's wrong is worth as much as knowing the right answer.

items.q: Hochschild's 1989 study of unequal housework is titled 'The Second' what?
items.why: Exact answer: 2. Estimation gets you near it; only the anchored number survives the exam hall.
